is.t: Regional Action Plan – consolidated view of the 32 country Action Plan worksheets

All descriptive fields are LIVE LINKS to the country Action Plan sheets (original language preserved). Grey columns are calculated. Nothing has been invented: missing owners, dates or statuses are flagged, not filled.
Rows with "Is action = 0" are empty spare slots that pick up new actions typed into the country Action Plan sheets (5 spare rows per country). Filter column Y = 1 to see actions only.
